description: Portfolio performance and risk stats — Performance and risk analytics from a return or price series: total return, CAGR, annualized mean and volatility, downside deviation, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, max drawdown with peak/trough/recovery positions, Ulcer index, historical 95% VaR and CVaR, skewness, kurtosis, best/worst period, % positive periods and a rating. Add benchmark= for beta, Jensen alpha, correlation, R squared, tracking error, information ratio and up/down capture. Params: prices= (levels) or returns= (percent per period; unit=decimal for 0.012 style); period=daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|yearly (default daily); optional rf= annual risk-free % (default 0), benchmark= same format and length. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_portfolio_stats
